original_test_intent: Repeatedly upload and remove a bounded object through the approved BMC console at 40C/-5% rails, verifying transfer integrity and BMC health.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Open BMC console in PuTTY, upload data, remove it, and repeat; source Script URL is provided.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Uploads normally and BMC SEL has no error.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED MANUAL ONLY and retained a genuine undefined-loop/workload conflict plus BMC filesystem safety gates.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Operator controls the physical margin; the existing project script may automate a bounded sandboxed transfer cycle after review.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 40C/-5% rails and repeated BMC upload/delete; the row does not define count or duration.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Approved script revision, interface, sandbox, test object, integrity method, one loop bound, free-space limits and recovery.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Chosen count/duration and object size define project coverage and cannot be claimed as an unspecified Master completion.

original_method: PuTTY console steps and the original Script URL are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Inspect and use the referenced project script if it enforces a canonical BMC sandbox, immutable object identity, integrity check and bounded loop.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Supported BMC firmware and its approved writable test area.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Script commit and BMC firmware must be pinned.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: BMC vendor filesystem/interface manual plus the approved internal script SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Uses the existing implementation rather than generating a new loop.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Depends on approved object size and count/duration.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Script commit, sandbox, object, integrity and loop rule.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Path traversal, full filesystem or deletion outside the sandbox can impair BMC service.

missing_inputs: Script revision and supported BMC version
safety_boundaries: No wildcard deletion or arbitrary BMC path
No automatic retry or unbounded loop
no_automatic_retry: A transfer failure is recorded and does not create an extra cycle.
engineer_owned_verdict: BMC/margin engineer evaluates integrity, health and approved coverage.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already distinguished irreducible manual margin work from bounded script automation and did not invent the missing loop rule.
